meta.title: A relative track that closes
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)

It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

prompt: Two objects, relative motion in the along-track and radial plane. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Relative position of a secondary object about a primary, in the along-track and radial plane. The track is a closed loop that repeats each revolution, staying within a few kilometres and returning to the same place.
accepted_first_actions: establish the relative motion in the hill frame
determine whether relative motion is bounded
establish relative motion in the along-track cross-track and radial frame
check whether the relative motion is bounded
expert_cue: The loop closes and repeats. Natural relative motion between two uncontrolled objects does not hold a bounded track over multiple revolutions without correction.
